definitions.explanation: A prefix indicating something has not yet happened or been done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{未経験|みけいけん}→未経験：17726_mikeiken⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can apply even without experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{未解決|みかいけつ}→未解決：17292_mikaiketsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{未成年|みせいねん}→未成年：13016_miseinen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧。

notes:
{未|み}〜 is a prefix meaning 'not yet' or 'un-,' indicating incompleteness.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{未経験|みけいけん}→未経験：17726_mikeiken⟧: inexperienced
- ⟦{未解決|みかいけつ}→未解決：17292_mikaiketsu⟧: unresolved, unsolved
- ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧: incomplete, unfinished
- ⟦{未成年|みせいねん}→未成年：13016_miseinen⟧: minor (underage person)
- ⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧: undecided, TBD
- ⟦{未知|みち}→未知：13014_michi⟧: unknown
- ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧: future
- ⟦{未婚|みこん}→未婚：14933_mikon⟧: unmarried
- ⟦{未払|みばら}い→未払い：18029_mibarai⟧: unpaid

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未|み}〜: not yet done (may happen)
- ⟦{無|む}〜→無：17750_mu⟧ / ⟦{不|ふ}〜→不：noentry⟧: not, without (negation)

{未|み} implies the action hasn't happened YET, suggesting it could happen in the future.
